messages:
Alice M.: Quick design sync — attaching a mock for a new 'Invoke Explorer' panel that merges run history + inline schema editor. High-level goal: make tool-calling visible, editable, and keyboard-first. Thoughts?
Sam R.: Love the single-pane approach. Main question: do we lose scanability for long runs?
Marco G.: Maybe collapsible groups by request with a compact summary row. Arrow keys to expand/collapse would help.
Julie K.: UX nit on copy: change 'Edit function' -> 'Edit tool definition' to match other places in the Console.
Tina L.: Accessibility: keyboard focus needs a deterministic order. If the inline editor opens as a modal, focus trapping should be explicit.
Khalid A.: Implementation note: prefer native <button> where possible for automatic keyboard/screenreader behavior. Avoid role="button" on divs unless necessary.
Sam R.: Agreed on native buttons. For the run rows, accessible name should include status + timestamp + model so screenreader users get enough context.
Marco G.: Prototype currently uses role="listbox" + aria-activedescendant for the run list. Thoughts on switching to list/region semantics?
Julie K.: list/region seems simpler. listbox implies single-select semantics which doesn't map cleanly to multi-expandable items.
Alice M.: Good call. Also: microcopy — in the tool call preview replace 'Args' with 'Arguments' and add a one-line hint: 'Edit to change what the tool receives.'
Sam R.: :thumbsup: For long JSON params we should collapse to a single-line summary with a chevron to expand the full JSON. Keeps scanability.
Khalid A.: For the inline schema editor, we should allow quick edits and an explicit 'Save' + undo affordance. Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd+S to save the function def.
Julie K.: Can we show small diffs inline when a function def changes between runs? Like a compact `+/-` line summary.
Marco G.: Yes — in run history row show a diff pill: "schema changed" with a popover showing the field-level diff. Keep it collapsed by default.
Tina L.: VoiceOver flow: when a diff pill opens, focus must move into the diff popover, and hitting Escape should close it and restore focus to the pill.
Alice M.: Good accessibility requirements — add to tickets. Also: keyboard nav inside the popover should support Up/Down to cycle fileds, Enter to open field detail.
Sam R.: UX question: where do action buttons live? current mock shows 'Re-run', 'Copy call', 'Edit def' inline on each run. For small screens that gets noisy.
Julie K.: Move primary action ('Re-run') to the left and hide secondary actions in an overflow menu (kebab). On mobile the kebab becomes the single action entry.
Khalid A.: Overflow menu must be reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space) and expose menuitems as role="menuitem" with aria-checked when toggles exist.
Marco G.: Performance note: rendering full parsed JSON for 50+ runs will be expensive. Use virtualization for the run list and keep the inline editor as an on-demand hydrated component.
Alice M.: Agree — optimistic render for summary, hydrate full JSON only on expand. Also cache parsed schema to avoid repeated parsing.
Tina L.: Copy-to-clipboard CTA: provide an inline confirmation toast that is announced to screen readers (aria-live="polite") and persists for 2s.
Sam R.: Small copy tweak: 'Copy call' -> 'Copy invocation' to avoid confusion with copy/paste UI language.
Julie K.: +1 'Copy invocation'. Also suggest a tooltip on hover: 'Copy full request payload'.
Marco G.: Quick technical example for inline schema edit payload (for the devs):
```json
{
  "name": "fetch_user",
  "description": "Return user profile",
  "params": [
    {"name": "user_id", "type": "string", "required": true}
  ]
}
```
Alice M.: Thanks. Can we add an undo stack per-run so accidental edits don't immediately propagate? Edits should be saved to a draft separate from live deploy.
Khalid A.: We'll implement a draft layer at the workspace level and only push to the model routing when the user explicitly 'Publish'.
Tina L.: Accessibility tests to add: screenreader navigation through run list, opening editor, saving draft, diff popover announce, copy toast announce.
Sam R.: I'll file the Accessibility checklist in the ticket.
Alice M.: Action items: Marco — update mock with list/region semantics + virtualization notes. Julie — microcopy updates and tooltip text. Khalid — keyboard/menu roles and draft/publish design. Tina — add voiceover test steps. Sam — file tickets and schedule a 30-min sync.
deploy-bot: Scheduled UX sync created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/ux-invoke-explorer-sync-1723585200 (tomorrow 11:00).
Tina L.: I'll add example screenreader recordings to the ticket before the sync.
Julie K.: One last nit — change the 'Expand JSON' chevron label to 'Show details' for clarity with assistive tech.
Alice M.: Perfect. Thanks everyone, we'll iterate on the mock and review in the sync.
